events.name: donation_result_viewed
events.description: Visitor lands on the thank-you page after the payment rail. The site asks the provider for the real status (Bold transaction lookup, Mercado Pago preapproval) and falls back to the return URL if the provider does not answer. North Star: donation_success = true and verified = true.

properties.name: payment_provider
properties.description: Payment rail (bold, mercado_pago).

properties.name: payment_status
properties.description: Final status. Bold: approved, pending, rejected, cancelled, not_found. Mercado Pago: authorized, pending, paused, cancelled. subscription_returned only when Mercado Pago could not be asked (unverified).

properties.name: donation_success
properties.description: True for Bold approved and Mercado Pago authorized; also true for an unverified approved/subscription_returned from the URL.

properties.name: verified
properties.description: True when the status came from the provider; false when it came only from the return URL.

properties.name: frequency
properties.description: one_time (Bold) or monthly (Mercado Pago).

properties.name: amount_value
properties.description: Amount in COP from the provider (monthly amount for Mercado Pago); for unverified Bold, read from the order reference.

rationale: Instruments the website's single conversion journey: turning visitors into supporters through the Súmate panel. Funnel: sumate_opened, sumate_help_type_selected (money, optional because it is preselected), donation_frequency_selected (optional, preselected), payment_flow_started, donation_result_viewed with donation_success true. North Star: donation_result_viewed with donation_success = true and verified = true, summing amount_value in COP. The status is confirmed server-side with Bold (transaction lookup) and Mercado Pago (preapproval), including the monthly amount; verified = false marks results read only from the return URL. payment_flow_failed captures payments that could not be opened. Country, city, session and UTM parameters are captured automatically by Mixpanel. No personal data is collected; session replays block all images because the site shows photos of minors.
